assumptions.ranking: Households without a vehicle, by count (ACS vehicle ownership), share as tiebreak. These are the people who cannot drive themselves out.

rankings.who_cannot_leave: Households without a vehicle, by count (ACS vehicle ownership), share as tiebreak. These are the people who cannot drive themselves out.
rankings.must_leave_may_need_help: Sum of state z-scores of counts: mobile homes, residents 65+, and residents with a disability. Mobile homes must evacuate in any hurricane; older and disabled residents may need help doing it.

assumptions.ranking_inputs: Physical and demographic only. No accessibility field, no hazard composite, and no race or ethnicity is an input.
assumptions.ranking_change: Changed after an equity audit. The first ranking summed four state z-scores of shares (no-vehicle, 65+, disability, mobile homes). In Lee County its top 15 tracts held only 14% of the county's households without a vehicle, because small tracts with high mobile-home and 65+ shares dominated it; ranking by count raises that to 34%. The two needs are now separate lists, both ranked by how many people, not what share. The original is reproducible with rank_tracts(ranking='composite_v0'). Race was used only to audit.

evidence_labels.RECORDED: Written in a federal record (FEMA NSS, Census ACS, CDC SVI, CMS, FEMA NRI). Historical: describes what was filed, not necessarily what is true today.
evidence_labels.UNRECORDED: The field is blank. Nobody wrote it down. This is never the same as 'no'.
evidence_labels.VERIFIED LIVE: Checked against Google Maps during this session, with a timestamp.
evidence_labels.MODELED: A statistical estimate (CDC PLACES), not a count.
evidence_labels.COUNTY-LEVEL: Published per county only (HHS emPOWER). Says how many, never which tract.
evidence_labels.APPROXIMATE: Derived from a federal record by our own approximation, such as a shelter matched to its nearest census tract centroid. Describes the neighbourhood, not the building.
